contentPattern.structure: field rows (type | name | label | placeholder/options | required) + submit row

suitableFor: content pages needing a name/email/subject/message form with a submit button
notSuitableFor: complex multi-step or conditional forms (use an Adaptive Form via forms-excat)

usage.note: Created from scratch: no vanilla 'form' block exists in the sta-boilerplate library and the forms-excat plugin is not enabled, so a standalone form-contact variant was built following the standard variant workflow. Used by travelling-pets contact form (rc4c5 / #contact-us).
